##### Project general facts

The Beach House is an exclusive collection of residences situated in the most prime beachfront location. Featuring a curated selection of studios, simplex, and duplex apartments, this landmark development models the luxury of simplicity and convenience. Exceptional living spaces with striking full-height floor-to-ceiling windows frame panoramic beach views, creating an urban oasis of luxury where residents can enjoy the perfect retreat for mind, body, and soul.

Residents enjoy a refined lifestyle with access to an array of world-class amenities, including an arrival lobby, resort beach, outdoor pool, and a fully equipped gym and spa. The development offers the perfect setting for every moment, from breakfast in bed to adventure through the Jebel Jais, exploring the waters of Ras Al Khaimah, afternoons on the private beach, evenings at Wynn Al Marjan, and nights of dancing. Every element is crafted to create a lifestyle of understated refinement and exceptionalism.

Every residence at The Beach House showcases a seamless fusion of contemporary design and timeless elegance. Meticulously crafted interiors feature open floor plans, floor-to-ceiling windows, and bespoke finishes that create an ambiance of understated refinement. The spacious layouts and premium materials ensure each home is a sanctuary of comfort and style, designed to accommodate all the moments to come.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Al Marjan Island, a premium waterfront location on what is fast becoming one of the most sought-after man-made islands in the world, this exceptional location offers residents a premium beachfront lifestyle. Surrounded by scenic mountains and a picturesque coastline, Ras Al Khaimah is an enchanting emirate rooted in a history that dates back over thousands of years, just a short drive from neighbouring Dubai.

The location is distinguished by its rapid development and significant growth potential. The eagerly anticipated opening of Wynn Al Marjan Island is set to redefine tourism in the emirate, with an array of gaming options, high-end restaurants, cafes, upscale boutiques, and sprawling malls on the horizon. Tourist numbers are expected to reach staggering levels annually by the end of the decade, providing real estate owners with opportunities for substantial returns on investment.

For those seeking a residence that embodies beachfront tranquility, luxurious living, and a prime Ras Al Khaimah address, Al Marjan Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, world-class entertainment, and strategic connectivity makes it one of the region's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can disregard convention and choose exceptionalism.
